lede: A quiet Sunday on the web with one real throughline. The story that actually crossed feeds was a gentle one: a one-minute clip of Charlotte Wainwright restoring old books, trending on Bluesky and Mastodon at the same hour and pitched openly as the opposite of grinding books up to feed AI. Underneath it the AI beat kept its steady drum, with a 'GPT-6 Astra on robot arms' demo working Hacker News and Product Hunt together, while the day's heaviest readership went somewhere much darker.
